tanvi: Quick sync — I want to outline the plan for decomposing the legacy v3->v4 shim into smaller adapters. thinking about safety, observability, and an orderly sunset.

mike: +1. rough idea? split into: ingress normalizer, auth-compat, streaming-envelope, and response-mapper?

sara: sounds reasonable. main worry: cross-cutting telemetry and tracing. adapters must preserve trace headers.

ben: also need a feature-flagged path so we can route a subset of tenants to the new adapter graph. no big-bang.

tanvi: exactly. proposal: 4-phase rollout
  1) sidecar adapters deployed, routed only for internal test tenants
  2) opt-in toggle for canary customers (5%)
  3) broad opt-in with rollback gates
  4) decommission legacy shim after metric stability window

mike: what are the rollback gates concretely? SLO spikes, error rate, and token cost delta? thresholds?

sara: suggest: error rate bump > 0.5% absolute, latency p95 > +80ms, or quality regressions flagged by eval-runner. any gate triggers auto-route-back for affected tenants.

ben: we need a cheap way to run golden comparisons between legacy and new graph for the same requests. shadow mode?

tanvi: shadowing yes — route duplicated traffic to adapter graph without influencing production response. but beware duplicate billing/compute. ops-bot: note that shadowing will double inference cost for shadowed requests.

ops-bot: @channel reminder: shadowed traffic uses same GPU pools; plan capacity buffer +30% or use burst pool.

mike: about decomposition boundaries: ingress normalizer should only touch request envelope and return normalized internal shape. auth-compat must convert old_auth headers to token v2. streaming-envelope converts chunk frames to streaming frames our runtime expects. response-mapper handles escape-hatches for legacy response shapes.

sara: keep adapters stateless where possible. any adapter that needs state should have a clearly versioned contract and backing store. prefer ephemeral in-memory caches with TTL.

ben: testing matrix: unit + property tests for each adapter, adapter-integration tests (local harness), and staging end-to-end with canary header. ci-bot: i can add matrix entries to CI. give me tags for test groups.

ci-bot: created job labels: adapter_unit, adapter_integration, adapter_shadow_e2e. will run adapter_shadow_e2e on staging only.

mike: observability: each adapter must emit these spans/metrics: adapter.exec.ms, adapter.errors, adapter.input.shape, adapter.output.shape, and a shim.correlation_id tag to tie multi-adapter traces together.

tanvi: agree. also add a metric shim.migration.diff_tokens to capture token-usage delta between old/new paths for cost analysis.

sara: we need a small schema registry for adapter I/O shapes. propose a proto file per adapter and automated validation in CI.

ben: proto + runtime validation + a lightweight fuzzer to find shape edgecases. can we reuse the existing schema service? mike: yes, extend schema-service v1 to support adapter schemas. add a feature flag to require validation.

mike: little implementation note: keep adapters as separate deployable units behind a shared adapter-runtime; avoids monolith rollouts. but that adds network hops. tradeoff: isolation vs latency.

tanvi: for low-latency tenants we can bundle the critical path adapters (ingress normalizer + auth-compat) into the same process; others run as sidecars. label as "latency-critical" tenant opt-in.

sara: deprecation timeline idea: announce 90 days before hard-sunset, but start telemetry and canaries 30 days earlier. final cutoff gated by no more than 0.1% active clients failing during the last 14 days.

ben: how will clients opt-out? we should provide an escape-hatch header X-RI-Shim=legacy to force legacy path for troubleshooting. log hits to that header.

mike: add plan for housekeeping: backfill support logs (who used legacy path) into bigquery daily so sales/support can reach out before cutoff. tanvi: yes, add a dashboard and weekly export csv.

ops-bot: housekeeping checklist created: capacity plan, burst pool config, GA monitoring, billing impact report. assigned to infra on Monday.

tanvi: outstanding questions: 1) exact rollback thresholds (sara to finalize), 2) schema-service extension (mike/ben), 3) canary cohort list + communication plan (pm + support).

sara: i'll draft a gates doc with numbers and a sample dashboard. drop it in #eng-runtime-docs and ping here when ready.

ben: i'll prototype the adapter harness and a small fuzzer by EOW.

mike: i'll sketch the deployment topology and latency budget for bundling vs sidecar.

tanvi: thanks folks. next sync Thursday. if anyone finds edgecases in existing shim tests, paste logs here.

sara: one example edgecase I saw: client sends mixed streaming + non-streaming frames in same session — we need clear rejection rules.

mike: good catch. add to shape validation + unit tests.

ben: ok signing off, will start PRs later today. :rocket:

ci-bot: noted PR triggers: adapter_unit -> runs on PR, adapter_integration -> runs on merge to staging.

ops-bot: monitored rollout job will post progress to #release-war-room.
